text:
zoe: creating a compact POC provisioning runflow for Nimbus Analytics. 3-week POC. dev path = Hosted API keys; security path = VPC + optional customer KMS. Need a one-page checklist SEs can follow.
lee: Agree. Keep dev path under 5 steps. Provide curl and SDK snippets, and quick perf checklist.
mike: I'll own Dedicated sizing and cost scenarios. For baseline: 50 qps avg -> 4 A100-equiv or int8 alternative. Will post numbers.
tara: Security intake: request CIDR, peering contact, data classification, KMS ARN (if CMEK), and desired log retention (30/90/365). I'll prefill answers for SOC2, enc-in-transit/rest, and pen-test cadence.
zoe: proposed runflow sections: 1) Intake (contacts + data class + SOW) 2) Hosted quickstart 3) VPC smoke-tests 4) Dedicated warmup 5) Handoff + rotation.
lee: hosted quickstart snippet:
```n# create scoped key (SE)
rwctl keys create --project nimbus-poc --ttl 7d --role inference:client
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-...
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
mike: dedicated warmup note: run synthetic traffic at 30% for 10m, then 75% for 5m before cutover. Canary route recommended (10% -> 50% -> 100%).
ops-bot: env-prov: nimbus-dev-hosted created by lee at 1993500100
tara: VPC smoke-test example:
```n# from customer bastion
curl -v --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/customer.pem https://private-api.redwood.net/health --resolve 'private-api.redwood.net:443:10.8.1.22'
```
zoe: action items: mike posts sizing + cost sheet, tara attaches security FAQ to ticket POC-621, lee shares hosted quickstart link with customer, SE to collect CIDR & peering contact before kickoff.
lee: i'll upload the one-pager runflow to /docs/poc-nimbus/runflow and ping customer for kickoff slots.
zoe: thanks all, keep updates in thread. if infra needs deep-dive i'll spin a war-room channel. :rocket:
